mapper.sql: crd10_excel_company_id AS excel_company_id, crd10_company_id AS company_id, crd10_bank_cd AS bank_code, f_cdnm('CreditCardCompany', crd10_bank_cd, crd10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS bank_name, crd10_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crd10_excel_company WHERE crd10_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY crd10_bank_cd collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crd10_excel_company (crd10_excel_company_id, crd10_company_id, crd10_bank_cd, crd10_note) VALUES (#{excelCompanyId}, #{companyId}, #{req.bankCode}, #{req.note})
